exposure: early skin-to-skin contact (SSC) after cesarean section program
outcome: perioperative pain with a visual analogue scale
cohort: The study included 172 parturient women who underwent Cesarean section (86 in the intervention group and 86 in the control group).
finding: The early SSC after CS program significantly improved birth satisfaction for women undergoing emergency CS and reduced infant hospitalization for infectious diseases and diarrhea for multiparas.
mod_finding: The early SSC after CS program showed a positive effect on the birth satisfaction of women undergoing emergency CS and reduced hospitalization for infants of multiparous women who had a CS.
